results.title: Cycling Around Taiwan: Why The Island’s Famous Bike Journey Is So Popular
results.description: Cycling around Taiwan is more than a long-distance ride. Known locally as Huandao, the journey has become a distinctive way to experience the island's landscapes, towns and culture.The official Cycling Route No. 1 covers about 960.8 kilometres and is designed to make a round-island cycling journey more accessible. For many riders, the appeal lies in combining a physical challenge with the freedom to discover Taiwan at road level.
